products_default_pack_quantity_check.name: products_default_pack_quantity_check
products_default_pack_quantity_check.value:
("products"."purchase_unit" = 'kg' AND "products"."default_pack_quantity" IS NULL)
        OR ("products"."purchase_unit" <> 'kg' AND "products"."default_pack_quantity" IS NOT NULL
          AND "products"."default_pack_quantity" > 0)

purchase_lines_received_packs_check.name: purchase_lines_received_packs_check
purchase_lines_received_packs_check.value: "purchase_lines"."received_packs" IS NULL OR ("purchase_lines"."packs" IS NOT NULL AND "purchase_lines"."received_packs" >= 0 AND "purchase_lines"."received_packs" <= "purchase_lines"."packs") OR ("purchase_lines"."packs" IS NULL AND "purchase_lines"."received_packs" = 0)

purchase_lines_received_costs_check.name: purchase_lines_received_costs_check
purchase_lines_received_costs_check.value:
("purchase_lines"."receipt_status" = 'partial'
          AND "purchase_lines"."received_usable_quantity" IS NOT NULL AND "purchase_lines"."received_usable_quantity" > 0
          AND "purchase_lines"."received_unit_cost_usd" IS NOT NULL AND "purchase_lines"."received_unit_cost_usd" >= 0
          AND "purchase_lines"."received_sale_price_usd" IS NOT NULL AND "purchase_lines"."received_sale_price_usd" >= 0)
        OR ("purchase_lines"."receipt_status" <> 'partial' AND "purchase_lines"."received_usable_quantity" IS NULL
          AND "purchase_lines"."received_unit_cost_usd" IS NULL AND "purchase_lines"."received_sale_price_usd" IS NULL)

daily_closes_approval_check.name: daily_closes_approval_check
daily_closes_approval_check.value: ("daily_closes"."status" = 'approved') = ("daily_closes"."approved_by" IS NOT NULL AND "daily_closes"."approved_at" IS NOT NULL)
